scope: Research candidates, not accepted renames or decompilation credit

extraction.method: Single-identifier token replacements within full git diff hunks (not capped API patches); duplicate old/new pairs coalesced. Multi-token replacements are not reconstructed.
extraction.limitations: Proposals preserve the external authors terminology, not independent semantic validation. Old-symbol absence does not prove the proposal was merged.
